items.reason: Inclusion: "Has either tissue agnostic tumors and documented RAS mutations or with glioblastoma with or without mutation in RAS"; RAS mutation is required for the non-GBM part of the population and matches the pan-RAS inhibitor, so the literal manual reading gives enrichment + matched. But GBM patients are explicitly not selected.

Title: "RSC-1255 Alone or in Combination With Hydroxychloroquine"; expansion gives RSC-1255 "in combination with continuous hydroxychloroquine" with a stated rationale ("the autophagy inhibitor hydroxychloroquine"), so it is a second investigational agent. Does not change S6 (RSC-1255 is a candidate).
Same as coder A item; the requirement applies only to non-GBM participants, which the manual does not address.

note: Policy question for XL (same as NCT06258018): does a candidate-matched requirement that applies only to non-GBM participants count toward candidate_matched_selection? Literal manual says yes (proposed); if XL rules it must apply to GBM participants, set candidate_matched_selection and any_molecular_selection false. Also: both coders kept RSC-1255 experimental_monotherapy; if HCQ is a co-investigational agent in the same registered arm, rule 5 would make RSC-1255 experimental_combination in the expansion portion (no effect on candidate status).
